world.title: All eyes are on Israel President Herzog as Netanyahu, Eisenkot fall short of majority
world.summary: Israel's recent elections resulted in no bloc achieving a majority, leaving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the opposition alliance short of seats. The next phase of government formation will hinge on President Isaac Herzog's decisions. This political impasse creates uncertainty for the nation's leadership, as various parties consider potential alliances to establish a functioning government.

world.title: 'Collision at 160-200kmph': Chilling details from Spain crash that killed 69
world.summary: A train collision in Spain resulted in 69 fatalities and over 200 injuries. The incident occurred due to a failure in the LZB railway signalling system, which caused trains to switch tracks unexpectedly. Preliminary investigations indicate that this signalling failure was a critical factor in the crash, highlighting significant safety concerns within the railway infrastructure.

world.title: Tanker in Strait of Hormuz hit by limpet mines, security sources say
world.summary: A tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was struck by two limpet mines attached by a small boat, resulting in a fire in its engine room and temporarily disabling the vessel. This incident marks the first successful use of such explosives in the waterway since the onset of the US-Iran conflict in February, according to maritime sources.

business.title: Nasdaq futures crash up to 2.5% as tech stock selloff deepens; Nvidia, AMD fall up to 7%
business.summary: Nasdaq futures fell by up to 2.5% as a global sell-off in technology stocks intensified, impacting major companies like Nvidia and AMD, which dropped by up to 7%. In Asian markets, South Korea's Kospi, Japan's Nikkei 225, and Shanghai's SSE Composite indices all closed lower, reflecting broader concerns about the tech sector's performance.

business.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Profit hits record high, but provisions jump 93%; asset quality improves
business.summary: Bank of Baroda reported a record quarterly net profit of ₹6,532 crore for Q2 FY27, a 35.8% increase year-on-year. However, provisions surged 93.3% to ₹2,381.8 crore from ₹1,232.47 crore, and operating expenses rose 7.4% to ₹8,477 crore. The global net interest margin (NIM) stood at 2.74%, indicating improved asset quality despite higher provisions.

business.title: 8 midcap stocks with over 100% profit growth in Q2FY27
business.summary: Eight midcap companies listed on the NSE reported over 100% year-on-year growth in quarterly net profit for Q2FY27, indicating significant profitability improvements compared to the same quarter last year. This data, derived from StockEdge's profitability scan, highlights the strong earnings performance of these firms based on the latest results announced for the September 2026 quarter.

technology.title: Reliance Digital offers iPhone 17 Pro at Rs 54,990 and iPhone Air at Rs 49,990 with exchange benefits of up to Rs 22,000: All details
technology.summary: Reliance Digital has reduced prices for the iPhone 17 Pro to Rs 54,990 and the iPhone Air to Rs 49,990. The retailer, an authorized Apple reseller, has also expanded its iPhone upgrade program, offering exchange benefits of up to Rs 22,000. This initiative aims to encourage customers to upgrade their devices while providing significant savings.

technology.title: Digital Signage Software: SIA Interactive Brings Dex Suite to Novastar
technology.summary: SIA Interactive has integrated its Dex Suite digital signage platform with Novastar's Taurus multimedia controllers, enabling LED displays to operate without an external media player. This integration reduces hardware needs and allows for remote content management and maintenance. The collaboration was supported by Novastar's technical team, enhancing operational efficiency for LED display operators.

technology.title: Apple boosts iPhone 17 cashback to Rs 8,000 to revive demand amid festive slowdown
technology.summary: Apple is increasing cashback on the iPhone 17 to boost demand during the festive season. From November 1 to 14, cashback for full-swipe transactions will rise to Rs 7,000, while EMI transactions will offer Rs 8,000. This promotion applies to all colors and variants of the iPhone 17, responding to a slowdown in sales and rising prices.

sports.title: Anderson 'sad' and 'quite shocked' by Lancashire release
sports.summary: James Anderson expressed sadness and shock over his release from Lancashire. He has not made a decision regarding his playing future but mentioned a desire for someone to facilitate his retirement when the time comes. Anderson's comments reflect his uncertainty about the next steps in his career following the recent announcement of his departure from the team.

sports.title: Bangladesh lose six in second innings but extend lead past 100
sports.summary: Bangladesh ended Day 3 of the first Test against West Indies at 79/6, with Jaker Ali and Nayeem Hasan contributing an unbroken 26-run partnership. A total of 12 wickets fell on a turning pitch, allowing Bangladesh to extend their lead past 100 runs. Bad light led to an early conclusion of play in Mirpur.

sports.title: Bangladesh lose six in second innings but extend lead past 100
sports.summary: On Day 3 of the first Test against West Indies, Bangladesh ended with 79/6, extending their lead past 100 runs. Jaker Ali and Nayeem Hasan contributed an unbroken 26-run partnership. The day saw 12 wickets fall, with the pitch offering significant turn. Bad light halted play early, leading to stumps being called around 4:30 PM in Mirpur.

health.title: Advanced Breast Cancer Care Offers New Treatment Possibilities
health.summary: A 26-year-old woman in Faridabad, India, diagnosed with triple negative breast cancer and a single lung metastasis, has become a focal point for discussions on individualized, multi-disciplinary approaches to complex breast cancer treatment. This case highlights the growing trend towards tailored management strategies in oncology, aiming to improve outcomes for patients facing challenging cancer diagnoses.

health.title: Gut health and mental well-being are closely linked, doctors explain the connection
health.summary: At the India Today HealthWealth Summit 2026, experts discussed the significant connection between gut health and mental well-being. They highlighted how the gut and brain communicate, affecting mood, stress, digestion, and immunity. Gastroenterologist Dr. Ashwini Chopra emphasized that lifestyle habits, food choices, and stress levels play crucial roles in maintaining this vital connection for overall health.

health.title: Stress can affect your gut health and digestion, experts explain the connection
health.summary: At the India Today HealthWealth Summit 2026, Dr. Ashwini Chopra and Rasik Chopra discussed the gut-brain connection, emphasizing how stress impacts gut health and digestion. They highlighted the importance of diet, sleep, exercise, and emotional awareness in supporting overall well-being. The discussion underscored the growing recognition of the link between physical health and mental well-being in healthcare conversations.

science.title: AI model says Earth's 5 mass extinctions never happened
science.summary: A Chinese scientist, Shuzhong Shen from Nanjing University, utilized an AI model analyzing fossil data to challenge the traditional understanding of Earth's five mass extinctions. The findings suggest that these events were not sudden, catastrophic losses of life as previously believed. Instead, the research indicates that the extinctions may not have occurred in the perceived manner.

science.title: NASA's Hubble And Webb Telescopes Spot Cat-Shaped Nebula In Space
science.summary: NASA's Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes have observed a cat-shaped nebula within the Carina Nebula, approximately 7,500 light-years from Earth. The nebula's unique shape is attributed to strong ultraviolet radiation and stellar winds from massive stars. These telescopes provide detailed views of the star-forming region, showcasing clouds of gas and dust that contribute to its appearance.

science.title: The SCHENGEN pathway regulates lignin barrier formation via the receptor-like cytoplasmic kinase BIK1 in plant immunity
science.summary: Research on Arabidopsis thaliana reveals that the SGN3 receptor kinase and CIF peptides play critical roles in lignin barrier formation during plant immunity. SGN3 activates the BIK1 kinase, linking pathogen recognition to lignin deposition. This study identifies a new immune function for SGN components, demonstrating their involvement in disease resistance through the SCHENGEN pathway, which also operates in root barriers.

entertainment.title: Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt to reunite on screen in Khalnayak Returns? Here’s what we know
entertainment.summary: Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt may reunite for the sequel, Khalnayak Returns, to the 1993 film Khalnayak. Reports indicate that filmmaker Subhash Ghai and his writing team are creating a new character for Salman, who will portray a police officer. Details about the project are still emerging, and further announcements regarding the film are anticipated soon.

entertainment.title: Ranbir Kapoor’s ‘Ramayana’ receives ‘U’ certificate in India; here’s the runtime and official synopsis
entertainment.summary: Ranbir Kapoor's film 'Ramayana', featuring Yash and Sai Pallavi, has received a 'U' certificate in India. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the mythological drama is set to release in theaters worldwide on November 5, just before Diwali. The film aims to depict the classic tale of good versus evil, appealing to a broad audience.

entertainment.title: 'I Had A Muscle Tear While Dancing': Shraddha Kapoor On Playing A Lavani Dancer In Eetha
entertainment.summary: Shraddha Kapoor will portray a Lavani dancer in the upcoming film Eetha, inspired by the life of renowned Maharashtra folk performer Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar. Kapoor shared her experience of sustaining a muscle tear while dancing for the role. The film, directed by Laxman Utekar, is set to be released in cinemas on December 4, 2026.
